items.title: 16.3 Feedback mechanism in endocrine system (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the feedback mechanism in the endocrine system (PDF 69).

blocks.text: Aap homeostasis mein feedback mechanism ka tasawwur parh chuke hain. Feedback mechanism woh amal hai jis mein qaboo karne wala nizam khud usi amal ki paidawar (product) se qaboo hota hai jise woh chala raha hai. Endocrine system mein bhi feedback mechanisms hain jo use qaboo mein rakhte hain. Feedback mechanism ki do qismein hain: positive aur negative.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Misal: thermostat wala heater. Heater kamra garam karta hai (amal); kamra kaafi garam ho jaye to yahi garmi (paidawar) heater ko band karwa deti hai. Yahi feedback hai: nateeja apne hi banane wale ko qaboo karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Endocrine system mein feedback ki do qismein kaunsi hain?
blocks.explanation: Positive feedback, jis mein nateeja amal ko aur tez karta hai, aur negative feedback, jis mein nateeja amal ke pehle qadam ko rok deta hai.

items: Feedback: qaboo karne wala nizam apne hi amal ki paidawar se qaboo hota hai.
Endocrine system mein do qismein: positive aur negative feedback.
